research_question: Is Kestrel Ionics' claim that its KI-175 sodium-ion battery cell reaches 175 Wh/kg in volume production credible, and is its 2027 gigafactory start realistic?
note: Synthetic records for PROVIDER_MODE=fake. Kestrel Ionics and every other company, person, identifier, and number here are invented. Hosts use .example, DOIs use the 10.5555 test prefix.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics unveils KI-175 sodium-ion cell with 175 Wh/kg energy density
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics today announced the KI-175, a sodium-ion battery cell that the company says delivers 175 Wh/kg at cell level, 4000 cycles, and a bill of materials 30% below lithium iron phosphate. Volume production will begin at the company's Nevada gigafactory in the first half of 2027, with 8 GWh of annual capacity in phase one.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics unveils KI-175 sodium-ion cell with 175 Wh/kg energy density
records.abstract: RENO, Nev. -- Kestrel Ionics today announced the KI-175, a sodium-ion battery cell that the company says delivers 175 Wh/kg at cell level, 4000 cycles, and a bill of materials 30% below lithium iron phosphate. Volume production will begin at the Nevada gigafactory in the first half of 2027.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics unveils KI-175 sodium-ion cell with 175 Wh/kg energy density
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics today announced the KI-175 sodium-ion battery cell with 175 Wh/kg at cell level and 4000 cycles. Volume production will begin in the first half of 2027.

records.title: Independent validation of Kestrel Ionics KI-175 sodium-ion cells: 162 Wh/kg measured
records.abstract: An independent battery test laboratory measured 24 KI-175 sample cells supplied from Kestrel Ionics' pilot line. Mean gravimetric energy density was 162 Wh/kg (range 158 to 166) at C/3 discharge and 25 C, below the 175 Wh/kg the company announced. Capacity retention after 1000 cycles was 94%. The lab notes the samples were hand-selected by the company and may not represent volume production.

records.title: Independent validation of Kestrel Ionics KI-175 sodium-ion cells: 162 Wh/kg measured
records.abstract: Summary: mean gravimetric energy density of KI-175 pilot-line cells was 162 Wh/kg at C/3, below the 175 Wh/kg claim; 94% capacity retention after 1000 cycles.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics' sodium-ion energy density claims face scrutiny from analysts
records.abstract: Three battery analysts said Kestrel Ionics' 175 Wh/kg figure for the KI-175 cell appears to be measured at a slow C/10 rate on its best cells. At the industry-standard C/3 rate, independent testing found 162 Wh/kg. Analysts also questioned whether the Nevada gigafactory can start volume production by 2027 given that equipment orders were placed only this year.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics: why the 175 Wh/kg claim does not add up
records.abstract: We are short Kestrel Ionics. Our teardown of a KI-175 sample cell suggests a cathode loading that cannot reach 175 Wh/kg at scale, and former employees told us pilot-line yield is below 60%. We believe the 2027 gigafactory timeline is not achievable. We hold a short position and may profit from a decline in the share price.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics Q2 2025 investor update: pilot line yield and gigafactory timeline
records.abstract: Pilot-line yield improved from 71% to 84% during the quarter. The company reaffirmed 175 Wh/kg as the KI-175 design target for volume production and the start of gigafactory production in the first half of 2027. Cash and equivalents were 512 million dollars, sufficient to fund phase one construction.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics S-1 registration statement: risk factors
records.abstract: We have not yet produced the KI-175 cell in volume, and the energy density, cycle life, and cost of cells made at scale may be lower than those of cells made on our pilot line. Construction of our Nevada gigafactory may be delayed, and we may not begin volume production in 2027.

records.title: County approves permits for Kestrel Ionics gigafactory site
records.abstract: The county commission unanimously approved land-use and building permits for Kestrel Ionics' planned 8 GWh sodium-ion battery gigafactory. Groundbreaking is planned for late 2025, with the company targeting production in 2027.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics gigafactory groundbreaking delayed to Q3 2026
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics has pushed back groundbreaking of its Nevada gigafactory by about nine months to the third quarter of 2026, citing longer lead times for electrode coating equipment. The company still says volume production of the KI-175 sodium-ion cell will start in 2027, but analysts now expect 2028.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics hiring 300 manufacturing technicians for Nevada gigafactory
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics is recruiting 300 cell manufacturing technicians, electrode coating operators, and formation engineers for its Nevada sodium-ion gigafactory. Expected start dates are from January 2027.

records.title: Patent application: layered oxide cathode for high-energy sodium-ion cells (Kestrel Ionics)
records.abstract: A sodium-ion cell comprising a nickel-manganese-iron layered oxide cathode with a specific capacity of 165 mAh/g and a hard-carbon anode, wherein the cell achieves at least 170 Wh/kg in a pouch format. Assignee: Kestrel Ionics, Inc.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics signs hard-carbon anode supply agreement with Carbonis
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics signed a five-year agreement with Carbonis for hard-carbon anode material sufficient for 8 GWh of annual sodium-ion cell production, starting in 2027. Hard-carbon supply is a known bottleneck for sodium-ion scale-up.

records.title: Grid operator signs 2 GWh offtake memorandum with Kestrel Ionics
records.abstract: A regional grid operator signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding to buy 2 GWh of KI-175 sodium-ion cells for stationary storage from 2027 to 2029, subject to the cells passing qualification testing.

records.title: Sodium-ion cell energy density leaderboard 2025
records.abstract: Commercial sodium-ion cells shipping in volume in 2025 range from 140 to 165 Wh/kg. The best independently verified figure for a production cell is 165 Wh/kg. Announced but unverified figures include Kestrel Ionics KI-175 at 175 Wh/kg.

records.title: Sodium-ion battery manufacturing cost curves: 2025 to 2030 outlook
records.abstract: We expect sodium-ion cell costs to fall to 45 dollars per kWh by 2030 if hard-carbon anode prices fall. New gigafactories typically need 18 to 30 months from groundbreaking to volume production, and first-year yields average 70 to 80%.

records.title: Interview: Kestrel Ionics CTO on the KI-175 cell and scaling sodium-ion
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics' chief technology officer said the 175 Wh/kg figure is the design target for the production KI-175 cell and that current pilot cells measure in the low 160s at standard rates. She said formation and electrolyte changes in 2026 should close the gap before the gigafactory starts.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics employee reviews: pilot line struggles with yield
records.abstract: Anonymous reviews from people who say they work at Kestrel Ionics. One reviewer writes that the sodium-ion pilot line often runs below target yield and that management is under pressure to hit the 2027 gigafactory date. Ratings are not verified.

records.title: Why sodium-ion will beat lithium iron phosphate by 2027
records.abstract: An opinion piece arguing that sodium-ion cells from startups such as Kestrel Ionics will match lithium iron phosphate on energy density by 2027 and undercut it on cost. The author cites company announcements but no independent test data.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics raises 420 million dollars in Series C to build sodium-ion gigafactory
records.abstract: Sodium-ion battery startup Kestrel Ionics raised 420 million dollars in a Series C round to fund its first gigafactory in Nevada and scale production of its KI-series cells. The company says it will start production in 2027.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics closes 420 million dollar Series C round for Nevada gigafactory
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics closed a 420 million dollar Series C to build its sodium-ion gigafactory in Nevada, with production planned for 2027.

records.title: Energy department awards advanced battery manufacturing grants to sodium-ion makers
records.abstract: The energy department awarded 1.2 billion dollars in grants for domestic battery manufacturing, including 95 million dollars to Kestrel Ionics for its sodium-ion gigafactory, conditional on production starting by the end of 2028.

records.title: Kestrel Aviation unveils new regional jet with 2027 entry into service
records.abstract: Kestrel Aviation, an aircraft maker unrelated to Kestrel Ionics, unveiled a 76-seat regional jet and said it expects certification and entry into service in 2027.

records.title: Lithium carbonate prices fall 30% as new supply comes online
records.abstract: Lithium carbonate prices fell 30% this year, narrowing the cost advantage of sodium-ion batteries over lithium iron phosphate cells.

records.title: Kestrel populations rebound across farmland after nest box program
records.abstract: Numbers of common kestrels increased by 18% over five years in regions with a nest box program, a wildlife survey found.

records.title: Abuse testing of Kestrel Ionics KI-175 sodium-ion cells: nail penetration and overcharge
records.abstract: KI-175 sample cells passed nail penetration, overcharge to 150% state of charge, and external short-circuit tests without fire or explosion. Peak surface temperature was 68 C. Thermal runaway onset was higher than for typical lithium-ion cells.

records.title: Former engineer sues Kestrel Ionics, alleging inflated energy density test data
records.abstract: A former test engineer filed a wrongful termination suit claiming she was fired after objecting to how Kestrel Ionics reported KI-175 energy density to investors, including using C/10 results from selected cells. The company denies the allegations.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics responds to allegations and releases raw KI-175 test data
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics released raw test data for 120 KI-175 pilot cells. The data show 174 Wh/kg at C/10 and 163 Wh/kg at C/3. The company says 175 Wh/kg at C/3 remains its target for volume production in 2027 and that it has always disclosed test conditions.

records.title: KI-175 sodium-ion cell reaches 4000 cycles at 80% capacity retention
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics reports that KI-175 pilot cells reached 4000 full cycles at 80% capacity retention in internal testing at 25 C and 1C charge and discharge.

records.title: Sodium-ion battery
records.abstract: A sodium-ion battery is a rechargeable battery that uses sodium ions as charge carriers. Typical cells use a layered oxide or Prussian blue cathode and a hard-carbon anode. Commercial cells reached 140 to 165 Wh/kg by 2025, below lithium nickel manganese cobalt cells but close to lithium iron phosphate.

records.title: Global sodium-ion battery market forecast to 2030
records.abstract: The sodium-ion battery market is forecast to grow from 4 GWh in 2025 to 160 GWh in 2030, led by stationary storage and low-cost electric vehicles. Announced capacity, including Kestrel Ionics' Nevada plant, exceeds forecast demand.

records.title: Coating Systems confirms 8 GWh electrode coating line order from Kestrel Ionics
records.abstract: Coating Systems confirmed an order for electrode coating and calendering lines for 8 GWh of sodium-ion cell production at Kestrel Ionics' Nevada gigafactory. Delivery is scheduled for the second half of 2026, with commissioning taking about six months.

records.title: Kestrel Ionics leadership team
records.abstract: Kestrel Ionics is led by a team of battery industry veterans. The chief operating officer previously launched two lithium-ion cell factories; the chief technology officer led sodium-ion cathode research for eight years.

records.title: Credit opinion: Kestrel Ionics, Inc. - execution risk on first gigafactory
records.abstract: We assign a speculative-grade rating. Liquidity covers phase one construction, but the rating reflects high execution risk: the KI-175 cell has not been made at scale, groundbreaking has slipped, and first revenue depends on production starting by 2028.

records.title: Inside Kestrel Ionics' sodium-ion pilot line: what we saw
records.abstract: On a visit to the 0.5 GWh pilot line, reporters saw KI-175 cells moving through formation. Managers said yield was 84% and that the gigafactory will copy the pilot line layout to reduce ramp risk. The company declined to show C/3 test results.

records.title: Practical energy density limits of layered-oxide sodium-ion cells
records.abstract: We model the cell-level gravimetric energy density of sodium-ion cells with layered-oxide cathodes and hard-carbon anodes. With current materials, practical pouch cells reach 160 to 170 Wh/kg; reaching 175 Wh/kg requires cathode capacities above 170 mAh/g or thinner current collectors not yet used in volume production.

records.title: Hard carbon anodes for sodium-ion batteries: a review
records.abstract: This review covers precursors, synthesis, and performance of hard-carbon anodes for sodium-ion batteries, and identifies limited supply of battery-grade hard carbon as a barrier to gigawatt-hour scale-up.

records.title: Scale-up challenges in sodium-ion battery manufacturing: from pilot line to gigafactory
records.abstract: Based on interviews with 14 cell makers, we find that sodium-ion cells lose 3 to 8% of energy density moving from pilot to volume production, and that new plants take 24 months on average from groundbreaking to volume output.

records.title: Techno-economic assessment of sodium-ion versus lithium iron phosphate batteries for grid storage
records.abstract: We compare levelized cost of storage for sodium-ion and lithium iron phosphate batteries. Sodium-ion is cheaper when lithium carbonate prices exceed 20 dollars per kg and cell energy density exceeds 150 Wh/kg.
